text:
maria: Quick pass on the new 'Activation wizard' in staging — sharing a few UX notes from today's design review.

josh: Thanks — can you drop the Figma link so I can eyeball the screens?

maria: Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/staging/activation-wizard-v3 (staging frames). Key surfaces: first-run checklist, sample projects picker, telemetry consent modal, and the top quickstart banner.

kim: Main concern: the persistent banner at the top steals vertical space on smaller laptops. At 600px height we lose the primary controls on the Projects list.

aisha: Agree — propose a collapsed pill state that expands when clicked. Also keyboard focus should land on the first primary action ("Pick a sample") rather than the dismiss X.

josh: Accessibility nit: the wizard steps are visual only. For screen readers we should expose aria-current on the active step and role="progressbar" on the step container with value min/max. Also the white-on-brand-blue CTA hits ~3.8:1 contrast; needs AA (4.5:1) or a darker tint.

maria: Copy suggestion for the hero banner: current long copy is "Get started: pick a sample project or run the quickstart guide" — shorter + clearer: "Pick a sample or run the quickstart." Thoughts?

kim: Behavior question: if a user clicks "Skip setup", should that persist in their account settings? We shouldn't keep nagging them every session. Maybe surface a "Resume setup" item in the Help menu instead.

aisha: Yes, persist a flag. UX: if skipped, show a small unobtrusive pill in the workspace header (not the full banner) with "Resume setup" so users can re-enter without the full takeover.

josh: For sample projects, default selection should be "Starter API" for most orgs. Add microcopy tags on each card like "learn-by-example" and "production-first" so users know intent.

maria: Metrics we should capture: wizard started, completed, skipped, and time-to-first-request. Proposed event names: onboarding.wizard.started, onboarding.wizard.completed, onboarding.wizard.skipped. Also capture sample_id when they pick a sample.

kim: Dev notes: we'll gate this behind a feature flag activation_v3 scoped to beta orgs. Can we stub telemetry events behind the flag until we're ready to roll?

deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded: activation-wizard-v3 at commit bf3a2d — available at https://staging.redwood.dev (visual changes).

aisha: :thumbsup: On the aria work I'll add: accessible label for the sample picker, ensure each sample card has an aria-describedby with a 1-line summary, and keyboard-only focus styles for the expansion pill.

josh: Microcopy tweak for CTA on sample cards: use "Open sample" instead of "Try sample" — feels more persistent and less ephemeral.

maria: Decision summary: implement collapsed pill + persist skip flag + add "Resume setup" pill in header + aria improvements + change CTA copy to "Open sample" + track the proposed events. I'll update the ticket and assign to kim and aisha. Thanks all!
